Acoustic guitar recordings

Source recording collection: University of Iowa Electronic Music Studios
http://theremin.music.uiowa.edu/

Edited and distributed by Nicholas Brosowsky in tonejs-instruments:
https://github.com/nbrosowsky/tonejs-instruments
https://github.com/nbrosowsky/tonejs-instruments/blob/master/sample-source-info.txt

Sample license: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/

MP3 files are redistributed unchanged. NOCTURNE transposes the nearest
recording in browser playback, with gain envelopes and room reverb.
